$comment: Two Circuits, round 1: the Drydock Ring round Drydock 2 (docs/specs/ISLAND-03-keelhaven.md §5.2). The hull is the Book App on practice-unread-count-bug; its tally board counts the unread books. Lap 1 (Q3.4, Cass) fixes the bug; lap 2 (Q3.5) bolts on the regression test's gauge. Every wrong pick goes back to the place that fixes it, with the course's reason. The places, lamps and controls are the game's; every word is this file's.

post.name: The work-order post
post.means: Understand the task in **Plan** mode, and at the end, your seal: is it ready?

stack.name: The plank stack
stack.means: Make a focused change in **Interactive** mode

caisson.name: The caisson
caisson.means: Run the tests and the build in **Terminal**

laps.title: Lap 1: fix the unread count
laps.order: #2 · Keep unread stats correct when filters are active

stations.title: Understand
stations.prompt: The work order says the unread count ignores the filters. Pick the plan.

options.text: Count the unread books from the books the filters show
options.result: The plan connects the stats to the books you see.

options.text: Count every book, then hide the count when a filter is on
options.reason: That hides the number. The plan has to connect the stats to the books you see.

options.text: Change the test so it expects 5
options.reason: That weakens a test. The plan fixes the code.

hints: What should the count be made from?
The stats have to follow the filters.
Count the unread books from the books the filters show.

stations.title: Change
stations.prompt: Moll’s crew is at the plank stack. They wait for your plan.
stations.text: Moll’s crew fits two planks to the tally gear, and carries one more to Drydock 1’s hull.

stations.title: Inspect
stations.prompt: Two chalk marks are on the tally gear, and one is on Drydock 1’s hull. What do you do?

options.text: Pry off the stray plank
options.result: A confirmation shows first. The slate now shows only the tally gear.

options.text: Ask the crew to revise it
options.result: The crew takes the stray plank back. The slate now shows only the tally gear.

options.text: Approve the slate as it is
options.reason: The diff isn’t focused. One mark is on another hull.

hints: Is every mark part of this job?
Look at the hull each mark is on.
Pry off the stray plank, or ask the crew to revise it.

stations.title: Test and build
stations.text: Tap each lit plank with the sounding hammer, then pull the sluice to float her.
stations.again: Already sounded. If the crew already ran the tests and build, don’t run them again.
hints: Each lit plank is a test. Tap every one.
Then pull the sluice: that’s the build.
Tap each plank once, one after another.

stations.title: Preview
stations.prompt: Choose the sea for the trial run: which filters do you test?

options.text: Fantasy and Unread, with the search empty
options.result: Only The Night Circus sails out, and the tally reads 1. With the bug, it read 5.

options.text: Unread alone
options.reason: All five unread books sail out, and the tally reads 5. This check can’t tell the bug from the fix.

options.text: Search for hobbit
options.reason: That’s a different issue: search case.

hints: Which check shows a different tally with the bug?
Two filters, and only one book should sail.
Fantasy and Unread, with the search empty.

stations.title: Your seal

options.text: Seal it: the diff is focused, the tests and build pass, and the preview shows the fix
options.result: Your seal goes on the post. Every lamp on the ring is green.

options.text: Seal it: Copilot says it’s done

hints: What does your seal rest on?
A confident reply is not evidence.
Seal it on the evidence: the diff, the tests and build, and the preview.

laps.title: Lap 2: guard the old leak
laps.order: Add a regression test: Fantasy and Unread, only The Night Circus, unread count 1

stations.title: Understand
stations.prompt: What must the new gauge prove?

options.text: It floods with the old leak, and stays dry after the patch
options.result: A regression test fails with the bug and passes with the fix.

options.text: It stays dry
options.reason: A gauge that stays dry with the old leak proves nothing.

hints: What would the gauge do with the old leak?
Before the fix and after it.
It floods with the old leak, and stays dry after the patch.

stations.title: Change
stations.prompt: Choose the gauge to bolt on.

options.text: A new gauge at the old leak: Fantasy and Unread, only The Night Circus, tally 1
A gauge that never floods
options.reason: It passes with the bug too.

options.text: Lower the old high-water mark

hints: Which gauge would flood with the old leak?
Don’t move an old mark.
A new gauge at the old leak.

stations.title: Inspect
stations.prompt: Check the slate. What did the crew change?

options.text: One new gauge that checks the books shown and the tally; no old mark moved
A new gauge, and the old high-water mark moved down to match
options.reason: An old mark moved: that weakens an existing expectation. The test should check the books the filters show.

hints: Did any old mark move?
A new gauge only. Old marks stay.
One new gauge that checks the books shown and the tally; no old mark moved.

stations.title: Test and build
stations.text: Five planks now: four old ones and the new gauge. Sound them, then float her.
hints: Each lit plank is a test. Tap every one.
Then pull the sluice: that’s the build.
Tap each plank once, one after another.

stations.title: Preview
stations.prompt: The trial run again, with the new gauge on.
stations.text: Fantasy and Unread, and the tally still reads 1.

stations.title: Your seal

options.text: Seal it: the new test checks what the filters show, and the tests and build pass
options.result: Your seal goes on the post.

options.text: Seal it: Copilot says the test is done
options.reason: That’s a claim, not evidence. Seal on a test that fails with the bug and passes with the fix.

hints: What does your seal rest on?
The test, the tests and build, not a claim.
Seal it: the new test checks what the filters show, and the tests and build pass.

text.title: The Drydock Ring
text.intro: The inner loop: understand, change, inspect, test and build, preview.
